examples.note_nl: Grok Build-update: multi-agent workflows betrouwbaarder, background agents zichtbaar op het dashboard.
examples.text:
Grok Build packed a serious upgrade into this release, making multi-agent workflows more reliable, easier to control, and much smoother to manage

Background agents and workflows now stay visible as active work on the dashboard, workflow status shows how many agents are still running, and stop controls work even when approval prompts are open. Permission rules that fail to load now trigger warnings instead of silently being ignored

Session recovery is also more reliable, manually saved file edi

examples.note_nl: Grok Build 1.0.77: Shift+Enter voor een nieuwe regel en MCP-servers die niet onnodig herstarten.
examples.text:
Grok Build v1.0.77 is out with a few practical updates. Standouts include new [ui] kitty_keyboard = "query" setting lets Shift+Enter insert newlines. Quote copy now preserves & in links and double-clicks no longer fold thoughts when. Also worth noting: mCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates.

Release Notes: v1.0.77 - 2026-11-05

Features

- New [ui] kitty_keyboard = "query" setting lets Shift+Enter insert newlines in unidentified terminals.

Bug Fixe

examples.text:
NEW:  Grok Bot now has the ability to place phone calls for users.

Calls are limited to the U.S. for now, with Washington and Illinois blocked.

examples.note_nl: Claude Code en Codex in de cloud vanaf een Linear-ticket, met parallelle agents bij grote tickets.
examples.text:
This runs Claude Code and Codex in the cloud with the plan you already pay for.

You only need to pay for the machine.

Here is what's cool about this:

You start from a Linear ticket, and the agent does the rest. If the ticket is too big, you'll get parallel agents working on it and returning a single PR.
